notes: Checked 2026-10-09. Read the entire 156917-character markdown in consecutive chunks, including Appendices A-E and references, and verified availability quotations and the p. 22 discrepancy against the 48-page PDF with PyMuPDF. Quotations preserve wording and punctuation with layout line breaks and invisible URL separators normalized. Only one data/code deposit is named. Appendices A-C provide instructions/prompts/scoring categories; Appendices D-E (Tables 7-8) provide selected illustrative responses, without participant identifiers or arms, and are not the complete response corpus. Table 2 gives sample prompts, not complete conversation transcripts. The public_participant_data status follows the requested criterion: the accessible workbook has a row per participant, an arm column and verified outcome scores, even though raw creative texts are unavailable and the OSF node is not globally public/indexed. These are not counted as deposits.
